electrolyte.concentration_basis: calculated dilution, not measured ionic concentration

interpretation.complex_sign: Z = exported Z' - j * exported (-Z''); phase = -exported (-Phase)
interpretation.interpolation: linear interpolation of real and imaginary Z against ln(f); magnitude and phase recomputed from complex Z
interpretation.area_normalization: Z * exposed area, not Z / area; this is area-normalized measured total impedance
interpretation.derived_initial_boundary_profile: bare-ngg-initial-fit.json (generated separately by fit_ngg_eis.py; applied in NggSweep.java)
interpretation.reason: PBS three-electrode measured impedance may include uncompensated electrolyte resistance. It is not directly the dry NGG-SC contact boundary impedance.
